title: Finite etale restriction to a punctured power-series section is surjective
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], d a positive integer, and B = A[[x_1,...,x_d]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Let z:Spec A -> Spec B be the constant-coefficient zero-section immersion [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let V be an open of Spec B with z^{-1}(V) equal to Spec A minus its closed point, and put V_0 = V times_{Spec B} Spec A. For every pair P,Q of finite etale V-schemes, the restriction map Hom_V(P,Q) -> Hom_{V_0}(P|V_0,Q|V_0) is surjective. No normality, integrality, connectedness or nonempty-cover hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For each n apply finiteEtale_adic_unique_lift to constantCoeff, which is surjective via constant power series, and the given restricted morphism. Choose the uniquely determined lift g_n and retain its over-V and restriction equalities.

Show coverTransition_n followed by g_(n+1) has the same over-V and zero-section equalities as g_n. The first equality follows from the projection identity, the second from zeroMap_n followed by coverTransition_n = zeroMap_(n+1). Uniqueness of the n-stage lift therefore gives compatibility.
Apply formal Hom algebraization to the compatible family to obtain psi:P -> Q over V matching every g_n.

Package psi as a morphism of finite étale covers. Compare its pullback with the supplied morphism using the two pullback projections. For the first projection, insert zeroMap_0 followed by coverMap_0 and use the n=0 algebraization and lift equalities. For the second projection use the over-base equality of the supplied morphism. Pullback extensionality and FiniteEtale.hom_ext finish.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0EY9 and 0EL8; explicit compatible finite-stage lifts from 0BQB, followed by algebraization and pullback projection comparison

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtale_powerSeries_punctured_section_restriction_surjective
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) :
    let z := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))
    ∀ P Q : V.toScheme.FiniteEtale,
      Function.Surjective ((FiniteEtale.pullback (z ∣_ V)).map (X := P) (Y := Q))
